issue_context.title: types: warning information is inconsistent with MySQL when convert string to double/float
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

Do the following in MySQL and TiDB
```
select '1x' + 1;
show warnings
```
<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

The warning content of both should be
```
mysql> show warnings;
+---------+------+----------------------------------------+
| Level   | Code | Message                                |
+---------+------+----------------------------------------+
| Warning | 1292 | Truncated incorrect DOUBLE value: '1x' |
+---------+------+----------------------------------------+
```
### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
MySQL:
```
+---------+------+----------------------------------------+
| Level   | Code | Message                                |
+---------+------+----------------------------------------+
| Warning | 1292 | Truncated incorrect DOUBLE value: '1x' |
+---------+------+----------------------------------------+
```

TiDB:
```
+---------+------+----------------------------------------+
| Level   | Code | Message                                |
+---------+------+----------------------------------------+
| Warning | 1292 | Truncated incorrect FLOAT value: '1x' |
+---------+------+----------------------------------------+
```

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

Master branch
